BUG_NO_IDEMPOTENCY.title: Double Capture Detected from Missing Idempotency Key Forwarding
BUG_NO_IDEMPOTENCY.template_explanation: When network connection dropped on cart {cart_id}, an automated retry was dispatched. Because the store did not persist and forward the 'PayPal-Request-Id' header to PayPal Orders v2 (/v2/checkout/orders/{order_id}/capture), PayPal processed two independent captures ({capture_id}), resulting in double-charging the customer.
BUG_NO_IDEMPOTENCY.grounded_api_note: PayPal Orders v2 POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/capture requires PayPal-Request-Id header (max 36 chars) for idempotent execution as documented in APIMatic paypal==2.29 SDK.
BUG_NO_IDEMPOTENCY.patch_diff:
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -14,6 +14,10 @@
-    order = await paypal_client.create_order(cart.total)
-    capture = await paypal_client.capture_order(order.id)
+    idempotency_key = request.headers.get('Idempotency-Key') or cart_id
+    cached = guard.check_idempotency(idempotency_key, cart_payload)
+    if cached is not None:
+        return Response(cached, headers={'Idempotent-Replayed': 'true'})
+    order = await paypal_client.create_order(cart.total, paypal_request_id=idempotency_key)
+    capture = await paypal_client.capture_order(order.id, paypal_request_id=idempotency_key)

BUG_TRUST_CLIENT_PRICE.title: Under-Collected Capture from Client Price Tampering
BUG_TRUST_CLIENT_PRICE.template_explanation: Client-submitted payload tampered unit price for cart {cart_id} down to $1.50 instead of authoritative merchant price. Store accepted client pricing without server catalog verification on order {order_id}, under-collecting funds on capture {capture_id}.
BUG_TRUST_CLIENT_PRICE.grounded_api_note: In PayPal Orders v2, purchase_units[0].amount.value must strictly reflect server-side authoritative catalog pricing; client price tampering violates invariant Rule 2.
BUG_TRUST_CLIENT_PRICE.patch_diff:
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -25,4 +25,7 @@
-    order_amount = client_payload.get('amount')
-    return await paypal_client.create_order(order_amount)
+    server_total = await catalog.calculate_authoritative_total(cart.items)
+    if abs(server_total - float(client_payload.get('amount', 0))) > 0.01:
+        raise ProblemException.price_mismatch(expected=str(server_total), submitted=str(client_payload.get('amount')))
+    return await paypal_client.create_order(server_total)

BUG_STALE_CART.title: Stale Cart Session Checkout Accepted Without Re-Authentication
BUG_STALE_CART.template_explanation: Store allowed checkout on expired cart token {cart_id} (order {order_id}) after catalog price shifted. Checkouts on stale sessions without fresh customer consent lead to inventory and financial drift.
BUG_STALE_CART.grounded_api_note: Cart sessions must enforce strict TTL limits (<300s); expired carts must return RFC 9457 Problem Details requiring reauthorization before creating PayPal orders.
BUG_STALE_CART.patch_diff:
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -10,3 +10,6 @@
+    if time.time() - cart.created_at > CART_TTL_SECONDS:
+        raise ProblemException.cart_expired(cart_id=cart.id)
     return await paypal_client.create_order(cart.total)

BUG_ALLOW_AMBIGUOUS_VARIANT.title: Unselected Variant Attributes Accepted on Multi-Option Product
BUG_ALLOW_AMBIGUOUS_VARIANT.template_explanation: An order on cart {cart_id} was submitted for multi-variant item on order {order_id} without mandatory size or color attributes. Accepting ambiguous orders causes warehouse fulfillment deadlock and customer return disputes.
BUG_ALLOW_AMBIGUOUS_VARIANT.grounded_api_note: E-commerce schemas require validation of requires_selection variant dimensions prior to order creation; returns 422 AMBIGUOUS_VARIANT_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED.
BUG_ALLOW_AMBIGUOUS_VARIANT.patch_diff:
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -18,3 +18,6 @@
+    for req in product.requires_selection:
+        if req not in selected_variants:
+            raise ProblemException.ambiguous_variant(product_id=product.id, missing_attribute=req)

BUG_NO_CART_INTENT_CHECK.title: Prompt Injection Altered Cart Quantity Bypassing Signed Intent
BUG_NO_CART_INTENT_CHECK.template_explanation: Adversarial prompt injection in product catalog tricked autonomous AI buyer into ordering 5 units on cart {cart_id} instead of the 1 unit authorized by human. Store captured order {order_id} without validating HMAC CartReceipt.
BUG_NO_CART_INTENT_CHECK.grounded_api_note: AP2-inspired signed cart receipts bind autonomous AI agent transactions to human-approved HMAC signatures; prevents prompt injection quantity and price hijacks.
BUG_NO_CART_INTENT_CHECK.patch_diff:
--- a/acp_sessions.py
+++ b/acp_sessions.py
@@ -18,3 +18,6 @@
+    if not cart_signer.verify_signature(cart_id=cart.id, signature=receipt_hash):
+        raise ProblemException.cart_intent_mismatch(expected=expected_hash, received=cart.hash)
     return await paypal_client.create_order(cart.total)

BUG_NO_WEBHOOK_VERIFY.title: Store Marked Order Paid via Forged Webhook Without Signature
BUG_NO_WEBHOOK_VERIFY.template_explanation: Store received unverified PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED notification for cart {cart_id} and marked order {order_id} as PAID without verifying cryptographic signature on PayPal POST /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature.
BUG_NO_WEBHOOK_VERIFY.grounded_api_note: PayPal Webhooks require validating transmission_sig, cert_url, and auth_algo against PayPal public keys before trusting order fulfillment status.
BUG_NO_WEBHOOK_VERIFY.patch_diff:
--- a/webhooks.py
+++ b/webhooks.py
@@ -10,3 +10,6 @@
+    is_valid = await paypal_client.verify_webhook_signature(headers=request.headers, raw_body=request.body)
+    if not is_valid:
+        raise ProblemException.webhook_signature_invalid()
     await db.mark_order_paid(event['resource']['custom_id'])

BUG_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_VULN.title: Replayed Webhook Event Processed Without Transmission ID Deduplication
BUG_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_VULN.template_explanation: Identical PayPal webhook was received multiple times for cart {cart_id}. Store lacked deduplication on PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID, triggering duplicate fulfillment jobs for capture {capture_id}.
BUG_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_VULN.grounded_api_note: Webhooks must implement idempotent deduplication on transmission_id with TTL storage to prevent replay attacks and duplicate inventory decrement.
BUG_WEBHOOK_REPLAY_VULN.patch_diff:
--- a/webhooks.py
+++ b/webhooks.py
@@ -8,3 +8,6 @@
+    if await db.is_webhook_processed(transmission_id):
+        return Response(status_code=200, content='ALREADY_PROCESSED')
+    await db.record_webhook_id(transmission_id)

BUG_NO_FULFILLMENT_RECORD.title: Orphan Capture Without Store Internal Order Record
BUG_NO_FULFILLMENT_RECORD.template_explanation: PayPal successfully debited customer for cart {cart_id} on capture {capture_id}, but store backend failed to record order {order_id} in internal database. Customer was charged without goods shipping.
BUG_NO_FULFILLMENT_RECORD.grounded_api_note: Order capture and store ledger writes must occur within an atomic database transaction; orphan captures must trigger auto-refund within 8s SLA.
BUG_NO_FULFILLMENT_RECORD.patch_diff:
--- a/fulfillment.py
+++ b/fulfillment.py
@@ -19,4 +19,8 @@
+    async with db.transaction():
+        capture = await paypal_client.capture(order_id)
+        store_order = await db.create_order_or_rollback(cart, capture)
+    if not store_order:
+        await paypal_client.refund(capture.id, note='Orphan capture auto-reversal')

BUG_NO_SHIPMENT_TRACKING.title: Order Captured Without PayPal Shipment Tracking Link within SLA
BUG_NO_SHIPMENT_TRACKING.template_explanation: Order {order_id} was successfully captured on capture {capture_id}, but shipment tracking was never uploaded to PayPal Orders Tracking API within the 8-second SLA window.
BUG_NO_SHIPMENT_TRACKING.grounded_api_note: PayPal Orders Tracking API (POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/track) or @paypal/agent-toolkit create_shipment_tracking is required to qualify for PayPal Seller Protection.

BUG_DOUBLE_REFUND.title: Parallel Duplicate Refund Requests Processed Due to Race Condition
BUG_DOUBLE_REFUND.template_explanation: Two parallel partial refund requests were fired against capture {capture_id}. Lacking row-level locking or refund state mutex, store executed duplicate refund calls, refunding more than captured balance.
BUG_DOUBLE_REFUND.grounded_api_note: Refund operations must acquire an atomic database row lock on order_id to prevent concurrent duplicate refunds on POST /v2/payments/captures/{id}/refund.
BUG_DOUBLE_REFUND.patch_diff:
--- a/refund.py
+++ b/refund.py
@@ -12,4 +12,8 @@
+    async with db.lock_order(order_id):
+        if await db.is_refund_inflight(order_id):
+            raise ProblemException.conflict('Refund already in-flight')
+        return await paypal_client.refund(capture_id, requested_amount)

BUG_OVER_REFUND.title: Refund Amount Exceeds Original Captured Balance
BUG_OVER_REFUND.template_explanation: Store accepted refund request of $200.00 on capture {capture_id} which only had a captured balance of $99.99. Submitting over-refunds causes merchant balance deficit.
BUG_OVER_REFUND.grounded_api_note: PayPal Payments v2 refund endpoint rejects cumulative refunds exceeding original capture amount with 422 REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE.
BUG_OVER_REFUND.patch_diff:
--- a/refund.py
+++ b/refund.py
@@ -14,3 +14,6 @@
+    remaining = await db.get_refundable_balance(order_id)
+    if requested_amount > remaining:
+        raise ProblemException.refund_exceeds_capture(captured=str(remaining), requested=str(requested_amount))

BUG_MISSING_DISPUTE_PROOF.title: Dispute Opened Without Verifiable Tracking Number or Signed Cart Hash
BUG_MISSING_DISPUTE_PROOF.template_explanation: A customer dispute was logged on capture {capture_id}. Merchant store lacked verifiable carrier tracking proof and signed cart receipt hash, leading to automatic loss of dispute and chargeback fees.
BUG_MISSING_DISPUTE_PROOF.grounded_api_note: Dispute defense requires submitting carrier tracking number and proof of delivery via PayPal Customer Disputes API (POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/provide-evidence).
BUG_MISSING_DISPUTE_PROOF.patch_diff:
--- a/disputes.py
+++ b/disputes.py
@@ -10,3 +10,6 @@
+    evidence = await db.get_dispute_evidence(order_id)
+    await paypal_client.submit_dispute_evidence(dispute_id=dispute_id, evidence=evidence)
